text_block_list.text:
Before leaving the hotel, I ponder the 
words I want to say to <chrname> for the Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe.

—The world's wall is thick. Formidable 
rivals await.

"I've trained endlessly to counter that. I 
believe I've done everything I possibly 
can."

...We can't do any more training. There is 
very little left that can be done for <chrname> 
now.

...My right hand is trembling. I steady it 
with my left hand and exhale.
—It's time.

text_block_list.name: Longchamp Spectator
text_block_list.text:
"This year is L'Iguannotte's year." "No, 
it's Venus Park's."

The crowd surging into the venue shouts 
the names of the Umamusume they believe 
in.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: "...Trainer <username>, take a deep breath."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
No matter who the opponent is, <chrname> will be 
just fine.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ...That's right!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>! Have no fear! We will become 
your confidence!

With those words, Chairwoman Akikawa 
hurriedly spread out a large piece of 
cloth—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: —This is a message for you all!!

Words of encouragement fill the banner. 
'You can do it' 'Run all the way to the 
end'—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Tracen Academy and the URA collaborated to 
gather messages of support from all across 
Japan!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Rally 'round! This flag alone cannot hold 
it all! We've received countless words of 
encouragement!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: —Everyone believes in you all!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Never forget! There are people who are 
captivated by your strength and entrust 
their hopes to you!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Even if Rigantona and Venus Park are 
frighteningly strong—"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"To us, you girls are the ones who shine 
far too brightly!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"To us, you girls are the stars we truly 
believe can become the best in the 
world!!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ...You're strong.

...I exhale the air trapped in my lungs. 
Breathe out, let it all out, breathe in—

I turn back to face <chrname>. This is my final 
major task left before the Prix de l'Arc 
de Triomphe.
choice_data_list:
...You don't need to feel like you have to 
win.

text_block_list.text:
I don't need thoughts like "What if I 
lose?" either.

During our preparation period up until 
now, an appetite for growth was necessary 
as fuel.

However, on the world's grandest stage, 
even desire itself can sometimes become a 
distraction to one's focus.

Swallowing down all my lingering feelings, 
I decided to convey it to <chrname>.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...That was a great send-off, Yayoi.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ...I wanted to be of use, too.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Because you've always been the one helping 
me.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mei. You've chased the dream of becoming 
the best in the world with me. Even after 
I took over for Mother.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
This project was something you really 
wanted to continue with Mother and the 
others... Yet you ended up stuck working 
with me, someone who knows nothing...

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, thanks.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
I bet old man Symboli and grandma Mejiro 
feel the same way.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
From the past to the future. ...Because 
there were those who inherited feelings 
from long ago, the romance of the "Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe" continues to this day.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Yours truly is glad I could serve as a 
bridge to Yayoi.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Let's witness the moment Japan's 
long-cherished dream is fulfilled 
together.
—I can hear their prayers.

text_block_list.name: Japanese Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Please...! <chrname>...! Hang in there, hang in 
there...! Give it everything...!!

—There was a feeling that had lingered in 
my heart all this time.

text_block_list.name: Man Looking at Phone
text_block_list.text:
Don't you dare lose...! I'm definitely 
gonna see you win...!

—No matter how many times I lose, no 
matter how impossible they say it is.

text_block_list.name: Woman on a Date
text_block_list.text:
You can do it...! If it's <chrname>, the title of 
world's best is――
—There was an ideal I kept yearning for.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
It is no longer an unreachable ideal. 
...The summit is already in sight.

—I have continued entrusting hope to a 
future called "someday."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Family Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
Compete with each other. Win and lose. 
Show me what lies “beyond” this road—with 
those legs of yours.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...Our dreams.

A single, pure emotion. A heart that 
yearns to be 'number one in the world.'

The romance that had driven us up to this 
day—was right here.

text_block_list.name: Rigauntona
text_block_list.text: ...Come here. Japanese horse girl.

text_block_list.name: Rigauntona
text_block_list.text:
...There is only one victor. I'll leave my 
mark on you, too.

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text:
"Then that victory shall be mine. I'll 
take you all down together, understood?"

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text: "For the pride of France...!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“And so, the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe 
begins once again this year—”
